title: Setup order overview
body: Recommended order: Companies → Currency → Administration → Party → Product → Inventory & Stock → Calendar → Financial → Health. Setup Hub: /setup. Guided: wf-system-setup. Impact: Companies enable currency, party scope, CoA, stock, and Health institutions. Financial CoA/FY/journals are SAO-only. Tax/HIE: needs confirmation. See module-setup-dependencies.md and financial-setup.md.
